newsitem.title: USA: Hearing set for U.S. Commerce Secretary nominee.
newsitem.headline: Hearing set for U.S. Commerce Secretary nominee.

text.p: The confirmation hearing for Secretary of Commerce-designate William Daley will be held January 22, Senate Commerce Committee Chairman John McCain, R-Ariz., said Wednesday.

Daley, a 48-year old Chicago lawyer and the brother of Chicago Mayor Richard Daley, was nominated by President Clinton on December 13 to succeed Mickey Kantor. Daley was the chief lobbyist for the North American Free Trade Agreement when it won approval in Congress.
